sources.title: Event sourcing: storing state as a sequence of events
sources.excerpt: Instead of storing the current state, every change is stored as an immutable event; the current state is derived by replaying them.

sources.title: Projections over an append-only ledger
sources.excerpt: Balances are projections of the ledger, rebuilt from the log when a projection's rules change.

sources.title: Snapshots for long event streams
sources.excerpt: Replaying a long stream is slow; a periodic snapshot bounds the replay.
